title: The best grand marshals of the Elks
summary: He names Ace Watson, Johnny Salisbury and Alexander as good marshals and says a good marshal is dignified and keeps the body in order.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: Well what about the Elks? Are you an Elk? Yeah. And you take care of the place now? Takes care of it now yeah. Tell me who do you think were some of the good grand marshals that the Elks had?
Ace Watson. That was the first one I'd named. That was the best Marshall ever had.
You ever see his picture on that record they have out? Yeah. You know that Eureka has a record out of Blue Collar and he's Ace's only.

Ace Watson. The next one behind him was Johnny Salisbury. He was a good Marshall. He was a good Marshall. And up until late now Alexander he was the next good one. We had another Marshall who died. I can't even think of his name. But he was a pretty good Marshall too.
But what makes a Marshall a good Marshall?

Well from his actions in a parade. See take a grand Marshall. You can be a grand Marshall and have too much rhythm in you. Now the best grand Marshall is the study man. Don't have all that jazz with him. See now I don't call them other Marshalls no Marshalls don't you see. Doing all that cutting up in the street.

That's right. And I don't call them no Marshalls. But Ace Watson was the best in the Orleans. Best Marshall in the Orleans. And he was dignified with what he did you know what I mean. And when he brought them funerals out there was a funeral.
Well what makes a Marshall good now? He's got to be dignified. Steady kind of fella. As he walks. Now what has he got to do though? What's his job exactly? I don't know.

His job is commanding his body in the back. To see that they do the right things. And if they get out of order it's his place to go through there and make them line up and get them right and keep them straight. Which he used to do that. But these others don't care though. They get in the front they're gone.
